title: [LOGGED OUT] Hero download badges link to the right stores
reason: All three hero badges shown with correct hrefs and target _blank

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Page loaded at https://site.ludus-game.com/ with the cookie banner.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss and it closed.

steps.text: Are three badges shown under the big LUDUS logo: "App Store", "Google Play" and "Web-Version"?
steps.saw: Under the LUDUS logo, left to right: "Download on the App Store", "GET IT ON Google Play", "GET IT ON Web-Version".

steps.text: Does the "App Store" badge link to https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/ludus-strategy-card-rpg-battle/id6446642912 (read the link, do not open it)?
Does the "Google Play" badge link to a play.google.com address that contains "com.studion.mergearena" (read the link, do not open it)?
Does the "Web-Version" badge link to https://ludus-game.com/game (read the link, do not open it)?
Do all three badges open in a new tab (target _blank)?
steps.saw: All three hero badges have target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer".
